target_premise: exactly one synthetic target added and remains; given not inferred
delete_rule: only baseline background, delete vector <= before, no deletion of target/new records
addition_rule: background addition vector nonnegative sum <= max_add
candidate_categories: all matching count-vector transitions; no probability weighting
zero_candidates: inconsistent with declared premise, not safe
change: delete+add can model background count changes, no record identity correspondence
